**Extraction notes:**

- **Treatment group (n=11):** Received OHI plus non-surgical periodontal therapy — extraction of hopeless teeth and scaling/root debridement with hand instruments and ultrasonic scaler, with review appointments every 4–6 weeks. Classified as `SI_alone` (subgingival instrumentation without systemic/local antimicrobials).
- **Control group (n=7):** Received OHI alone during the study period; deferred periodontal treatment was provided after the 6-month follow-up. Classified as `usual_care`. (One participant was lost to follow-up but n=7 reflects those randomised.)
- Follow-up was 6 months for both arms (blood taken at baseline and 6 months per Section 2.1).
